rules: Career Goals supplies personal criteria and exceptions; the master supplies candidate facts. Public Review defines only extraction, ratings and score routing.
Run owns objective duplicate discovery; IDs or verified posting-specific links confirm identity, names/dates corroborate. Preserve actual application history.
Review scores and routing live only in stages/review.md. Use its ordered decisions, preserve unknown evidence, and pin its automatic content fingerprint.

Agents validate current scored Review evidence before entering Queued. A live Queued status, including a human choice, authorizes Prepare without another fit or company gate. Reassess existing queues only on explicit request.

Prepare reuses an approved base only with complete coverage and a current master; otherwise it tailors from the closest base under the registered resume guidelines. Base creation is offline. resume_ready checks the recorded path evidence.
Curate maintains company targeting proposals and funding evidence; only humans set Allow/Exclude.

Run stops after Prepare: Ready (verified resume and approved/resolved required answers), Needs answer or Apply manually. Only the explicit Submit command submits, under stages/submit.md: Applied needs verified proof; every failure is Apply manually. Preserve Applied, legacy outcomes, uncertain attempts and historical data; never reopen them automatically.
Manual notes is permanent; only verified Feedback is cleared. Company discovery is not restricted to recent funding, and the current user defines applicable company types/stage rules.

Prepare inspects all accessible required application questions; each required answer must be grounded in a current master/role-resume/Career Goals passage or be a nonempty Approved bank answer or Resolved role-question Final answer; the bank holds only gaps. Sensitive questions need approved answers even when optional. Drafts and incomplete form coverage block Ready; Prepare never fills or submits forms.
review_identity: SHA-256 of the exact Review file, computed automatically by scripts/role_gate.py
